description: Compare gnomAD v4 genome variant density in the LRIT2 cassette exon against constitutive coding exons and intron in the same 3 kb window
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

EN="https://rest.ensembl.org"
t=requests.get(f"{EN}/lookup/id/ENST00000372113?expand=1",
               headers={"Content-Type":"application/json"},timeout=120).json()
ex=sorted([(e["start"],e["end"]) for e in t["Exon"]])
print("MANE ENST00000372113 exons (GRCh38, minus strand gene):")
for s,e in ex: print(f"   {s}-{e}  ({e-s+1} bp)")

WLO,WHI=84221500,84224500
MX=(84222828,84222857)

q="""{ region(chrom: "10", start: %d, stop: %d, reference_genome: GRCh38) {
   variants(dataset: gnomad_r4) { variant_id pos ref alt consequence
     genome { ac an af } exome { ac an af } } } }""" % (WLO,WHI)
V=requests.post("https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/api",json={"query":q},timeout=300).json()["data"]["region"]["variants"]
g=[v for v in V if v["genome"] and v["genome"]["an"] and v["genome"]["an"]>50000]
print(f"\n{len(V)} variants in window; {len(g)} with gnomAD genome AN > 50,000 (WGS, uniform coverage)")
print("median genome AN:", int(np.median([v['genome']['an'] for v in g])))

# regions to compare, all inside the 3 kb window
const=[(s,e) for s,e in ex if s<WHI and e>WLO]
regions={}
for i,(s,e) in enumerate(const):
    regions[f"constitutive exon {i+1} ({e-s+1} bp)"]=(max(s,WLO),min(e,WHI))
regions["micro-exon (30 bp)"]=MX
# intron control: everything in the window not in any annotated or cassette exon
occupied=set()
for s,e in list(const)+[MX]:
    occupied|=set(range(max(s,WLO),min(e,WHI)+1))
intron_pos=sorted(set(range(WLO,WHI+1))-occupied)

def stats_for(positions,label):
    P=set(positions)
    vs=[v for v in g if v["pos"] in P]
    n=len(P)
    afs=[v["genome"]["af"] for v in vs]
    return dict(region=label, bp=n, n_variants=len(vs),
                variants_per_kb=1000*len(vs)/n,
                n_af_gt_0p1pct=sum(a>=0.001 for a in afs),
                n_af_gt_1pct=sum(a>=0.01 for a in afs),
                max_af=max(afs) if afs else 0.0)
rows=[]
for lab,(s,e) in regions.items():
    rows.append(stats_for(range(s,e+1),lab))
rows.append(stats_for(intron_pos,f"intron control ({len(intron_pos)} bp)"))
R=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print("\ngnomAD v4 genomes, variant density by region:")
print(R.to_string(index=False))

# Poisson test: micro-exon density vs intron density
mx=R[R.region.str.startswith("micro")].iloc[0]
itr=R[R.region.str.startswith("intron")].iloc[0]
cx=R[R.region.str.startswith("constitutive")]
lam=itr.n_variants/itr.bp*mx.bp
p_lo=stats.poisson.cdf(mx.n_variants,lam)       # depleted vs intron?
print(f"\nmicro-exon {mx.n_variants} variants over {mx.bp} bp; intron rate predicts {lam:.2f}")
print(f"  Poisson P(X <= observed | intron rate) = {p_lo:.3f}  (small = depleted, i.e. constrained)")
lam_c=cx.n_variants.sum()/cx.bp.sum()*mx.bp
print(f"  constitutive coding exon rate predicts {lam_c:.2f} over 30 bp")
print(f"  coding rate {1000*cx.n_variants.sum()/cx.bp.sum():.1f} /kb vs intron rate {itr.variants_per_kb:.1f} /kb")

# any variant disrupting the micro-exon splice sites?
don=range(84222822,84222831); acc=range(84222855,84222878)
ss=[v for v in g if v["pos"] in set(don)|set(acc)]
print(f"\ngnomAD genome variants in the micro-exon splice sites: {len(ss)}")
for v in sorted(ss,key=lambda x:-x["genome"]["af"])[:8]:
    print(f"   {v['variant_id']}  AF {v['genome']['af']:.4f}  {v['consequence']}")

cons=pd.Series([v["consequence"] for v in g if MX[0]<=v["pos"]<=MX[1]]).value_counts()
print("\nVEP consequence of micro-exon variants against the MANE transcript:")
print(cons.to_string() if len(cons) else "   none")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12.5,4.6))
a=ax[0]
lab=[r.split(" (")[0] for r in R.region]
col=["#2c6fbb" if r.startswith("const") else "#d1495b" if r.startswith("micro") else "#8d99ae" for r in R.region]
a.bar(range(len(R)),R.variants_per_kb,color=col)
a.set_xticks(range(len(R))); a.set_xticklabels(lab,rotation=25,ha="right",fontsize=8)
a.set_ylabel("gnomAD v4 genome variants per kb")
a.axhline(itr.variants_per_kb,ls="--",color="#8d99ae")
a.set_title(f"Micro-exon variant density matches intron\nPoisson p = {p_lo:.2f} for depletion vs intron",fontsize=10)

a=ax[1]
pos=np.array([v["pos"] for v in g]); af=np.array([v["genome"]["af"] for v in g])
a.scatter(pos,np.clip(af,1e-6,1),s=6,color="#8d99ae",alpha=0.5,label="window variants")
sel=(pos>=MX[0])&(pos<=MX[1])
a.scatter(pos[sel],np.clip(af[sel],1e-6,1),s=40,color="#d1495b",zorder=5,label="inside micro-exon")
for s,e in const: a.axvspan(max(s,WLO),min(e,WHI),color="#2c6fbb",alpha=0.15)
a.axvspan(*MX,color="#d1495b",alpha=0.3)
a.set_yscale("log"); a.set_xlabel("chr10 position (GRCh38)"); a.set_ylabel("gnomAD genome allele frequency")
a.set_title("Allele frequencies across the locus\n(blue bands: constitutive coding exons)",fontsize=10)
a.legend(fontsize=8)
plt.suptitle("Human population variation across the LRIT2 cassette exon",fontsize=12.5)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

R.to_csv("out_LRIT2_gnomad_density.csv",index=False)
print("\nsaved out_LRIT2_gnomad_density.csv")
